description: This Java class defines an HTTP endpoint for managing device credentials in the Eclipse Hono platform. It handles HTTP routes related to retrieving and updating credentials for devices, integrating with Vert.x web framework and event bus for message passing.

classes.name: CredentialsManagementHttpEndpoint
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractHttpEndpoint to provide HTTP endpoints for managing device credentials, including routes for fetching and updating credentials.

methods.name: CredentialsManagementHttpEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the endpoint with a Vertx instance; marked with @Autowired for dependency injection.

methods.name: getEventBusAddress
methods.description: Returns the specific event bus address for credentials management messages.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Provides the name identifier of this HTTP Endpoint, combining API version and endpoint identifier.

methods.name: addRoutes
methods.description: Configures HTTP routes for credential retrieval and update, including CORS setup and request handling.

methods.name: updateCredentials
methods.description: Handles updating device credentials via event bus message passing, constructing request payloads from HTTP context.

methods.name: getCredentialsForDevice
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET to fetch credentials for a specific device, sending a message on the event bus and handling the response.

methods.name: getCredentialsResponseHandler
methods.description: Creates a response handler that sets the HTTP response based on the outcome of credential fetch/update, including JSON payload handling.
